caveats: The notice changes the POSTC eligibility floor through waivers; it does not by itself prove the final wording, effective date, or roll-call details of Danbury's September 2026 ordinance amendment.

data.publisher: Connecticut Police Officer Standards and Training Council
data.title: General Notice 25-05 - Further waiver of citizenship requirement

evidence.claim: POSTC states that RCSA § 7-294e-16(c) contains a U.S.-citizenship condition for probationary police candidates and that POSTC may waive regulations under CGS § 7-294d(a)(20).

POSTC states that at its November 19, 2020 special meeting it partially waived the citizenship requirement to extend eligibility to permanent legal residents, and that this waiver was reflected in the POSTC-51 form.

POSTC states that at its March 13, 2025 meeting it further waived the citizenship requirement to extend eligibility to DACA recipients in addition to permanent legal residents, and updated POSTC-51 accordingly.

summary: Primary Connecticut POSTC notice documenting the 2020 lawful-permanent-resident waiver and the March 13, 2025 extension of police probationary-candidate eligibility to DACA recipients.
title: Connecticut POSTC General Notice 25-05 — further waiver of citizenship requirement
